order: row-major; north to south, west to east
pixelRegistration: origin is upper-left cell EDGE; values refer to native 0.25-degree grid cells; first centre = [-118.875,33.875]
annualComputation: Float64 sum of all 12 valid original float32 monthly normals, then one float32 storage cast; never average or multiply by days. One missing month makes the whole annual value missing.
spatialMask: Keep a native cell only when its footprint has positive-area intersection with the original 32-state INEGI land union. Do not discard a coastal cell because its centre is offshore. Native cell values apply to gridded climate support, not exact local station measurements. Mask outside land at output-pixel stage.
landIntersectionMaskMeaning: 1 means footprint intersects Mexican boundary; independent of precipitation validity. Allows distinguishing missing Mexican support from outside-Mexico cells.
